jobs.title: Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Role Description
The Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst role is a part-time remote position focused on identifying, assessing, and monitoring fraud and financial crime risks across digital platforms and AI-related workflows. In this role, the analyst reviews transactional and behavioral data, conducts risk assessments, and develops scenarios and indicators to detect suspicious activity. The person in this role will prepare clear reports, document findings, and recommend control improvements to reduce exposure to fraud and financial crime. Day-to-day work includes analyzing trends, collaborating with internal stakeholders to refine risk criteria, staying current on regulatory expectations, and supporting the design of safeguards that align with evolving AI practices. The role also involves contributing to best practices and knowledge resources for fraud prevention and risk management.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Risk Analysis capabilities to evaluate complex data, identify patterns, and assess fraud and financial crime exposure.
Candidates should possess Finance and Statistics skills to understand transactional flows, quantify risk, and support data-driven recommendations.
Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to present findings clearly, write concise reports, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Candidates should possess familiarity with financial crime concepts, fraud detection tools, and basic regulatory and compliance principles.
Relevant experience in risk management, fraud analysis, compliance, or a related financial services role is beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Criminal Justice, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is preferred.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage part-time hours responsibly, and adapt to new AI-driven tools and methodologies.

jobs.title: Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description
In this part-time hybrid role based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with some work-from-home flexibility, the Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst will monitor transactions and customer activity to identify potential fraud and financial crime risks. The role involves analyzing patterns and anomalies, reviewing alerts, and conducting investigations using internal systems and external data sources. The analyst will prepare clear reports and summaries of findings, recommend risk mitigation actions, and support the implementation of controls and policies. Day-to-day responsibilities also include collaborating with compliance, operations, and finance teams, responding to inquiries from internal stakeholders, and staying up to date with relevant regulations and industry best practices.
Qualifications

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and identify risk indicators.
Experience in risk analysis and financial crime detection within finance or related fields.
Proficiency in statistics and quantitative methods for assessing fraud patterns and trends.
Effective communication skills, including the ability to present findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorist financing (CTF), and fraud prevention frameworks.
Experience working with transaction monitoring tools, case management systems, or data analysis software.
Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, statistics, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
High attention to detail, integrity in handling sensitive information, and the ability to work independently in a hybrid environment.
Prior experience in financial services, fintech, banking, or risk consulting is an advantage.
